entry.title: PQC output type discussion
entry.summary: The integration of segwit subversions into blockchain transactions presents a technical challenge, characterized by a trade-off between increased output size and added complexity. Specifically, the implementation options available would either augment each output by an additional byte or necessitate extra computational efforts to accommodate an additional bit. Both scenarios have their drawbacks, with neither being particularly advantageous due to the implications on system efficiency and operational simplicity. This dilemma highlights the ongoing challenges in optimizing blockchain technology for better scalability and performance without compromising on the existing infrastructure's integrity and functionality.
